title: I deployed an 11-agent swarm from my car
description: Right now I'm in my car sending voice messages to 3 Codex agents and 8 Claude Code agents running on my computer back home. They're collaborating, posting my content, reviewing PRs on my repos, watching my business metrics, all at the same time. If you've never deployed an agent swarm from your phone you really should feel it once. It runs on a system I built called cortextOS. Link in bio.
